lastCompletedStory.title: Auditor audits the provided record only; identity/collision checks use git refs, prior-art is git-log and non-blocking

nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-273) shipped: both subagent-auditor.md copies (templates/ source-of-truth + .claude/ runtime mirror) now instruct the auditor to trust the spawn-prompt-embedded issue record (Issue ID/Title/Description/Branch/Acceptance Criteria from US-001's buildAuditorTaskPrompt) verbatim and to never re-resolve issueNumber/branchName via gh. Section E (Repo invariants) gained two new checklist items (17: branch-collision via git refs only - git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/<branch> + git ls-remote origin <branch>, never a same-numbered GitHub PR, nonexistent branch is never a collision; 18: prior-art/duplication signals sourced from git log, always severity:suggestion, never critical/important). The project-specific F section was renumbered up by 2 in both files (.claude: 19-25 was 17-23; templates: 19 was 17) to keep the checklist's global numbering sequential - purely cosmetic, no test parses these numbers. src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated via bun run embed-vendor to stay in sync (embed-vendor:check is clean). No external library was touched by this story (pure agent-instruction/documentation edit) so Step 5.5 recorded lib:none. Full check:all spine (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) is green with no budget changes needed.
